label: If a situation can be impossible, it is actually impossible
paraphrase: Conditional on the affirmative alternate report: if a situation can be impossible, it is actually impossible. The source takes its contrapositive, with possibility/impossibility duality, to imply that a possible situation is necessarily possible. This records the alternate input and proposed interpretation; it asserts neither actual respondent assent nor a proved modal axiom, source of metaphysical possibility, or rigid necessary individual.
